name: zclass_process_deferred_work
description: zClass::ProcessDeferredWork respects the deferred-processing gate, processes dirty type-list buckets in original order, drains pending node frees, and reports whether work was skipped.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this dispatcher; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x44e920 validates the deferred-processing guard, dirty-bucket checks, ProcessPendingRemovals calls, pending-free drain, return 1 when skipped, and return 0 after processing.

The native smoke verifies deferred-disabled skip behavior, dirty-bucket cleanup through ProcessPendingRemovals, pending-free drainage through ProcessPendingFrees, and null free-list error propagation in the same list subsystem.
